Unnecessarily complicated sentences

teachings on egolessness and the elegance of
simplicity instead becomes an inadvertent, personal
exhibition of lexical prowess. The author's compulsive
reliance on an embellished vocabulary, far from
enriching the narrative, obfuscates the very essence of
the subject. It feels less like a thoughtful exploration of
